title: Good: startup writability probe prevents silent mis-config at launch
description: The .stoa_write_probe pattern in FsStore::open writes and immediately removes a sentinel file to verify the directory is writable at startup. A future contributor might suggest removing it as 'unnecessary' since write errors will surface later. Defend it: a misconfigured read-only mount will silently accept ingest traffic for hours before the first write attempt surfaces the error. The probe catches this at startup with a clear error message, which is the right tradeoff.
